problem: Match pairs 个=cái and 件=cái share the native text 'cái'. match.tsx resolves a native tile by text (first pair wins), so 件 can never be matched: the exercise cannot be completed and every correct attempt on 件 is marked wrong.
fix: Give 件 its own gloss, e.g. 件='cái (áo, việc)' and 个='cái (chung)', or swap 件 for 张=tờ; add a self-check rule: native texts in one match must be distinct.
decision: fixed: 件 is glossed 'chiếc; cái (áo, việc)' in the lexicon, so the match card reads 'chiếc' beside 个 'cái'. zh-check-answers.py rule 10 'match-native' flags a match with two equal Vietnamese cards (match.tsx resolves a card by its text); no other match had one.

problem: 'Rất vui được quen bạn.' Tiles 很 快乐 你 我 认识 高兴. 我很高兴认识你 (the standard textbook form) is built from the same tiles and rejected.
fix: Add alternative: 我 很 高兴 认识 你
decision: fixed: alternative 我 很 高兴 认识 你.

problem: 'Cho tôi thử một chút.' Tiles 一下 试 给 我 扫. 给我试一下 is the most literal and fully natural rendering of 'cho tôi thử' and is rejected (only 我试一下 accepted).
fix: Add alternative: 给 我 试 一下
decision: fixed: alternative 给 我 试 一下 (给我试一下 has no other order, so the 给 rule does not apply to 试).

problem: 'Gửi ảnh cho tôi nhé.' Tiles 的 我 吧 给 照片 打 发. 发照片给我吧 (V + O + 给 + person) is correct, common, and buildable from the tiles; rejected.

decision: fixed in the generator library: W() adds every order of the same tiles that zh_text.order_variants allows (time word before or after the subject; 给 + person before the verb phrase or after its object, for 发/打/打电话/寄/送/写/传; 住在 + place ⇄ 在 + place + 住); zh-check-answers.py rule 10 'tile-order' flags a word bank that leaves one out. The rule reached 5 word banks, 4 of them named by the reviewer (+ uk-l2-e4), and the string form of the same orders reached 3 typed answers and 2 writing slots (uc-l0-e7, uj-l0-e6, uo-l2-e2, zh.write.p_ask, zh.write.r_note), none named.

decision: fixed in the generator library: W() adds every order of the same tiles that zh_text.order_variants allows (time word before or after the subject; 给 + person before the verb phrase or after its object, for 发/打/打电话/寄/送/写/传; 住在 + place ⇄ 在 + place + 住); zh-check-answers.py rule 10 'tile-order' flags a word bank that leaves one out. problem: 'Tôi không có em gái.' Key 我没有妹妹 with no alternatives. 我没妹妹 (没 alone for 没有, the unit's own topic) is correct and very common; rejected.
fix: Add alternative: 我没妹妹

The rule reached 2 typed answers, both named here.

problem: 'Hôm qua tôi không đi.' Only 我昨天没去 / 昨天我没去. 我昨天没有去 and 昨天我没有去 are equally correct; rejected.
fix: Add alternatives: 我昨天没有去 | 昨天我没有去
decision: fixed in the generator library: zh_text.variant_spellings lists 没 ⇄ 没有 before a verb or noun (an A没A question and a clause-final 没有 keep their shape); Y(), spoken variants, writing slots and scenario replies all widen by it and zh-check-answers.py rule 10 flags an answer that leaves one out. The rule reached 2 typed answers, both named here.

problem: 'Tôi ăn cơm rồi.' 我吃过了 / 我吃过饭了 — the everyday reply to 你吃饭了吗 — is rejected (过 is taught two lessons later and in u3-l3). Same on up-l3-e3 ('Tôi đã ăn cơm rồi.').
fix: Add alternatives: 我吃过饭了 | 我吃过了 | 我已经吃过饭了 | 我已经吃过了
decision: fixed: 我吃过饭了 | 我吃过了 | 我已经吃过饭了 | 我已经吃过了 on ud-l2-e7 and on up-l3-e3.

problem: 'Tôi đến muộn mười phút.' 我来晚了十分钟 (来晚 is taught in u0-l1-e7 and accepted in zh.speak.k_sorry) is rejected; also 我晚了十分钟.
fix: Add alternatives: 我来晚了十分钟 | 我来晚了10分钟 | 我晚了十分钟 | 我晚了10分钟
decision: fixed: 我来晚了十分钟 | 我晚了十分钟 (the digit forms come from widen).

problem: 'Rẻ một chút đi.' Accepts 便宜一点儿吧 | 便宜点儿吧 | 便宜一点吧 but not 便宜点吧 — the most frequent spoken form, and the 一点儿/一点 pair rule applied to 点儿. 便宜一点儿 without 吧 is also natural.
fix: Add alternatives: 便宜点吧 | 便宜一点儿 | 便宜一点 | 便宜点儿 | 便宜点
decision: fixed: alternative 便宜一点儿 (no 吧), and a generator rule (zh_text.bit_spellings: adjective + 一点儿 ⇄ 一点 ⇄ 点儿 ⇄ 点) adds 便宜点吧, 便宜点儿, 便宜点; the numeral rule no longer reads 便宜一点 as 'one o'clock' (it had produced 便宜1点). The rule reached only this item. Prompt now 'Bớt chút đi.' (language finding).

problem: 'Tôi tên là Nguyễn Hải.' Accepts 我叫阮海 | 我是阮海; 我的名字是阮海 and 我的名字叫阮海 are correct and are accepted by the speech items for the same prompt (zh.speak.l_name); rejected here.
fix: Add alternatives: 我的名字是阮海 | 我的名字叫阮海
decision: fixed: 我的名字是阮海 | 我的名字叫阮海.

problem: 'Quét mã được không?' Accepts 可以扫码吗 | 能扫码吗 | 我可以扫码吗. 扫码可以吗 is the commonest word order at a till and is accepted for the same intent by zh.scenario.shop_fruit; 能不能扫码 / 可不可以扫码 are also correct.
fix: Add alternatives: 扫码可以吗 | 能不能扫码 | 可不可以扫码 | 可以扫码不
decision: fixed: 扫码可以吗 | 能不能扫码 | 可不可以扫码 | 可以扫码不.

problem: 'Tôi gọi điện cho mẹ.' Only 我给妈妈打电话. 我打电话给妈妈 (equally standard) and 我给我妈妈打电话 are rejected.
fix: Add alternatives: 我打电话给妈妈 | 我给我妈妈打电话 | 我打电话给我妈妈
decision: fixed: 我给我妈妈打电话 by hand; the 给 order of zh_text.order_variants adds 我打电话给妈妈 and 我打电话给我妈妈 (rule 10).

problem: zh.write.cp5_like_music slot 'like' = 喜欢音乐 only. 我喜欢听音乐 (arguably the most natural Chinese for 'thích âm nhạc') tokenizes 喜欢 听 音乐, so the contiguous run is missing and the checkpoint item fails; 我爱音乐 fails too.
fix: Slot variants: 喜欢音乐 | 喜欢听音乐 | 爱音乐 | 爱听音乐
decision: fixed: slot like = 喜欢音乐 | 喜欢听音乐 | 爱音乐 | 爱听音乐.

problem: zh.write.a1cap_note_station slot 'meet' = 见. 见面 is a course lexeme, so the lexicon-bound tokenizer makes 我们五点在火车站见面吧 one token 见面 and the 见 slot is not realized: a correct capstone answer fails. 五点在火车站等你 also fails.
fix: Slot variants: 见 | 见面 | 等你 | 等我
decision: fixed: slot meet = 见 | 见面 | 等你 | 等我.

problem: zh.write.p_link: slot 'work' = 上班 | 去工厂 | 去公司; 然后去工作 ('sau đó đi làm', very natural) fails. Slot 'link' = 然后 only, though the instruction says 'Dùng một từ nối' (以后 / 再 also link: 我吃了早饭以后去上班).
fix: work: + 去工作 | 工作; link: + 以后 | 再 | 之后
decision: fixed: link = 然后 | 以后 | 再 | 之后; work = 上班 | 去工厂 | 去公司 | 去工作 | 工作 (also up-l2-e7, which mirrors the task).

problem: Price replies accept 一碗十八块 but not 十八块一碗 — the 'price + per unit' order the course teaches (苹果五块钱一斤, ui-l1-e3; 多少钱一斤). Same gap in the two reserved price items. Speech items have no requiredConcepts, so only listed variants pass.
fix: m_price + 十八块一碗 | 十八块钱一碗; cp4_price_tea + 五块一瓶 | 五块钱一瓶; a1cap_price_coffee + 二十块一杯 | 二十块钱一杯
decision: fixed in the generator library: zh_text.price_spellings gives the price per unit in both orders and with or without 钱 (一碗十八块 ⇄ 十八块一碗 ⇄ 十八块钱一碗); spoken variants, typed answers and writing slots widen by it (rule 10). It reached the 3 price speech items and their 3 exercise mirrors, all named; 0 beyond.

problem: 他（　）我的哥哥。 with pool 本 是 喜欢 热 回 名字: 他喜欢我的哥哥 ('he likes my older brother') is also grammatical and meaningful, so the distractor 喜欢 is also correct when the item is scored on its own.
fix: Change the stem so only 是 fits, e.g. 我（　）越南人。 (我喜欢越南人 is still possible, so avoid a person/nationality noun) — safest: 这（　）我的书。 (这喜欢我的书 is ungrammatical); keep 喜欢 for a_r3_01 only.
decision: fixed: the stem is 这（　）我的书。 — of the pool 本 是 喜欢 热 回 名字 only 是 fits; 喜欢 stays the key of a_r3_01.

problem: 'hai người' tiles 二 人 个 本 两. 两人 (no 个) is correct Chinese (common in writing and set phrases: 我们两人) and is rejected; the item tests 两 vs 二, which 两人 also shows.

problem: 'Tôi ở ký túc xá.' Vietnamese 'ở' also means 'live in' (the course itself renders 'Tôi sống ở ký túc xá' as 我住在宿舍 in uj-l0-e6). 我住在宿舍 / 我住宿舍 are defensible and rejected.

problem: 'Chìa khoá ở trên bàn.' Only 钥匙在桌子上. 钥匙在桌子上面 and 钥匙在桌上 are correct and common; rejected (上面 is not a lexeme, which matters only for display).
fix: Add alternatives: 钥匙在桌子上面 | 钥匙在桌上
decision: fixed: 钥匙在桌子上面 | 钥匙在桌上.

problem: 'Cái áo này màu trắng.' Only 这件衣服是白的. 这件衣服是白色的 is the most natural rendering of 'màu trắng' and what a pinyin IME offers for baise; rejected. Same for the spoken zh.speak.cp4_desc_shirt.
fix: Add 这件衣服是白色的 | 这件衣服白色的 (typed); speech + 这件衣服是白色的 | 白色的衣服. If the self-check forbids non-lexeme hanzi in alternatives, add 白色 as a lexeme.
decision: fixed: typed 这件衣服是白色的 | 这件衣服白色的; zh.speak.cp4_desc_shirt (and zh.cpi.s4.desc_shirt) + 这件衣服是白色的 | 衣服是白色的 | 白色的衣服. 白色 (with 红色, 黄色) is now a lexeme through the ETL (CC-CEDICT bái sè).

problem: 'Tôi đến từ Việt Nam.' 我来自越南 (来自 = lai tự, the likeliest guess of a Vietnamese learner) is correct and rejected.
fix: Add alternative: 我来自越南

problem: 'Tôi là công nhân.' Only 我是工人; 我是一个工人 / 我是一名工人 are correct and very commonly produced; rejected.

It reached 5 typed answers (ua-l3-e7, uo-l1-e1, uo-l3-e0, uo-l3-e2, zh.cpi.s2.type_vietnamese), 3 speech items with their mirrors (l_from, cp4_vietnamese, cp4_student) and 1 scenario reply (cp6_new_colleague) — only uo-l3-e0 was named.

problem: 'Tôi thích nghe nhạc.' Only 我喜欢听音乐 (no alternatives); 我喜欢听歌 is the everyday phrase for 'nghe nhạc', 我爱听音乐 also correct. ul-l3-e5 'Tôi thích âm nhạc.' accepts only 我喜欢音乐 although 我喜欢听音乐 is a natural rendering.

problem: 'Năm nay bạn bao nhiêu tuổi?' Accepts 你今年几岁 but not 你今年几岁了, and not 你今年多少岁 / 你今年多少岁了 (a direct rendering of 'bao nhiêu tuổi').
fix: Add alternatives: 你今年几岁了 | 你今年多少岁 | 你今年多少岁了 | 今年你多少岁
decision: fixed: 你今年几岁了 | 你今年多少岁 | 你今年多少岁了 (今年你… by the time-word rule).

problem: 'Hôm nay nóng.' 今天天气很热 (the unit's own sentence pattern 今天天气很好) is correct and rejected; also 今天很热啊.
fix: Add alternatives: 今天天气很热 | 今天天气热
decision: fixed: 今天天气很热 | 今天天气热.

uncertain: 美 is not a course lexeme; adding it to a typed alternative may trip the reading self-check.
problem: 'Mùa thu rất đẹp.' Key 秋天很漂亮 is acceptable but a native says 秋天很美 first; 秋天非常好看 is missing while 秋天非常漂亮 is listed.
fix: Add alternatives: 秋天很美 | 秋天非常好看 | 秋天真漂亮
decision: fixed differently: 美 is no course word and 漂亮 is odd for a season (language finding zh-vi:uf-l2-e6), so the prompt is 'Mùa thu thời tiết rất đẹp.' and the key 秋天天气很好 | 秋天的天气很好 | 秋天天气非常好 | 秋天天气真好.

problem: 'Sinh nhật tôi là ngày năm tháng năm.' The written-standard 日 (五月五日) is rejected, and so are 我生日五月五号 / 我生日5月5号 (no 的, no 是) while their 的-forms are listed. Same 日 gap on the form zh.write.cp5_form_clinic (四月五号 only) and the birthday speech items.
fix: Typed: + 我的生日是五月五日 | 我生日是五月五日 | 我生日五月五号 | 我生日5月5号 (and digit mixes); form slot + 四月五日; speech + …日 forms
decision: fixed: the date rule of zh_text.variant_spellings (月…号 ⇄ 月…日) widens typed answers, spoken variants and writing slots (rule 10), and 我生日五月五号 / 我生日5月5号 were added by hand. Reach: ud-l1-e7, the two birthday speech items with their exercise mirrors (um-l3-e8, zh.cpi.cap.speak_birthday) and the clinic form slot (with zh.cpi.s5.form_clinic) — all named.

uncertain: Usage of 可以 for learned ability is disputed among teachers; many natives accept it in speech.
problem: 我___说一点儿汉语 ('Tôi biết nói một chút tiếng Trung') with options 会 想 要 可以: 我可以说一点儿汉语 is heard from natives and is not clearly wrong.
fix: Replace the distractor 可以 with 是 or 在.
decision: fixed (no owner decision needed): the distractor 可以 is replaced by 是, so the doubt about learned-ability 可以 no longer arises.

problem: 几 → key 'mấy' with distractor 'bao nhiêu'. Vietnamese routinely renders 几 as 'bao nhiêu' (几个 = bao nhiêu cái, 几岁 = bao nhiêu tuổi), so the distractor is also a defensible gloss.
fix: Replace 'bao nhiêu' with 'ai' or 'gì'.
decision: fixed: the distractor 多少 ('bao nhiêu') is replaced by 谁 ('ai').

problem: 'Tôi sẽ đến muộn ba mươi phút.' Missing natural forms: 我会晚到半个小时 / 我要晚半个小时到 (半个小时 = 30 phút), 我要迟到三十分钟, 我会晚三十分钟到.

decision: fixed: key 我会晚到三十分钟 (language finding) with 我晚到三十分钟 | 我要晚到三十分钟 | 我会迟到三十分钟 | 我要迟到三十分钟 | 我会晚三十分钟到 | 我会晚到半个小时 | 我要晚到半个小时.

problem: 'Tôi muốn làm một thẻ ngân hàng.' 我要办一张银行卡 / 我想办银行卡 are rejected although zh.scenario.bank_account accepts 我要办银行卡 for the same intent.

problem: 'Tôi đau đầu.' / 'Tôi đau bụng.' accept 我头疼 | 我头很疼 and 我肚子疼 | 我肚子很疼 only. 我的头很疼, 我的肚子疼 and the widespread 我头痛 / 我肚子痛 are rejected.

problem: 'Xin dừng ở đây.' (taxi) — 请在这儿停车 / 在这儿停车吧 (停车 is a lexeme) are the commonest taxi phrasing and rejected.

problem: 'Cảm ơn!' key 谢谢！ with no alternatives; 谢谢你 / 谢谢您 are natural and accepted by the course's speech items for thanks; a checkpoint should not reject them.

problem: zh.write.o_family slot 'like' = 喜欢做饭; 我喜欢做菜 ('nấu ăn' is as much 做菜 as 做饭) and 我爱做饭 fail.

problem: zh.write.p_who slot 'morning' = 早上 | 每天早上. 'buổi sáng' is equally 上午; 阮南上午喝咖啡 fails.

problem: zh.write.cp5_note_movie slot 'invite' = 吧 | 好吗. 小王，晚上七点一起去看电影，怎么样？ (the most common invitation tag) and …好不好？ fail.

problem: requiredConcepts accept wrong answers: l0 [[第一, 是, 对]] — 不是 and 不对 tokenize as 不 + 是/对, so '不是，我以前来过' passes as 'first visit'. Same leniency: a1cap_shift_change l0 [[可以, 能, 没问题, 好的]] passes 不能 / 不可以 as acceptance; taxi l1 passes 不好; cp6_clinic_cough l1 [[不, 没, 没有]] passes any sentence with 不 (我很不舒服) as 'no fever'.
fix: Use multi-token concepts: clinic_reception [[第一次, 是第一, 对，第一]] ; shift_change [[可以, 能, 没问题]] plus a grader rule or authored check that a concept run is not preceded by 不/没; cough l1 [[不发烧, 没发烧, 没有发烧, 没有]].
decision: fixed (coordinator decision QC-2026-11-05 §1.2, commit ab15feae): the speech and scenario grader is negation-aware, so 不是 / 不对 / 不能 / 不好 no longer realise 是 / 对 / 能 / 好. Content fix for cp6_clinic_cough: its no_fever concept is now [不发烧, 没发烧, 没有发烧, 没有], so 我很不舒服 is not 'no fever'. Rule 10 'concept-negator' of zh-check-answers.py flags a scenario concept group that holds a bare 不 / 没 / 别 / 不是 / 不要 / 不用; it also caught cp6_supermarket_pay (concept now [不要了, 没有了, 不用了]), beyond the sample.
